title: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan on Mass Media (1999, as amended 2007) (excerpts related to hate crimes) (English)
text:
[unofficial translation]



Law of the Republic of  Kazakhstan of 23 July, 1999, № 451-I 



"On  the mass  media"



amended by law of RK № 264-III. of 19.06.07.



(...)



Article 25. Responsibility for the disturbance of legislation about the mass media



Owner, editor in chief (editor) of the media bear responsibility,  established by the legislative acts of republic Kazakhstan, for distribution o f communications and materials, which contain propaganda or agitation of a forced displacement of the constitutional system, disturbance of the integrity of republic Kazakhstan, the undermining of the National Security, war, social, racial, national, religious, class and ancestral superiority, cult of cruelty, violence and pornography, independently of how they were obtained.



(...)
